notes: GitHub artifacts contain source and an unsigned iOS Simulator preview. They are not device-installable IPAs, App Store releases, insurance appraisals, or evidence of real purchases.
The app and source archive retain the committed numeric base version. Candidate channel, source commit, build tool versions and payload hashes identify the preview separately.

Free access permits one room and ten items in total. The planned non-consumable Pro purchase has a USD 19.99 local StoreKit test price; production availability and prices require App Store Connect configuration.

Inventory storage is bounded to 80 MiB of originals. Restore remaps a recovered attachment when a regular original filename collides with different contents, preserving prior bytes and the home/room/item identities. Unsafe symlink collisions are rejected.

Stable source/simulator promotion needs acceptance of the exact RC. Physical-device testing, signing, Apple agreements, production StoreKit configuration and App Review remain separate release requirements.
